title: Capture a Gemini CLI quota sample
goal: A neutral sample of the Gemini CLI's documented quota output for the adapter
acceptance: The owner runs the copy-paste command the step gives and pastes the output with account identifiers removed
The sample shows which fields hold the used share, window and reset time
privacy: Ledger metadata and invented fixtures only; no transcripts or personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: one CLI run and a paste. Not a measurement. Gemini CLI 0.68.0 (installed in a scratch folder on 2026-11-18 with the owner's approval), signed in with the owner's Google account (`GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true`, no settings changed), refuses to run: "IneligibleTierError: This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals. To continue using Gemini, please migrate to the Antigravity suite of products." There is no `/stats` output to sample. No actual: not timed.
